primary_interpretation: Retrospective reconstruction of Day-60 EPSS from current saved text and structured features; not a historical exploitation forecast.
primary_text_policy: All current nonempty saved source documents, deduplicated within CVE/source; explicit EPSS score/percentile disclosure candidates quarantined. No claim of historical source availability.
continuous_leads: Every h from 1 through 90-t for anchor t; missing or date-ineligible targets are masked.
continuous_history: All available scores from Day 0 through t, with masks and observation age; no future values. Recent 10/20/31-day views are prespecified secondary ablations, not an automatic optimum.
continuous_loss: Mean over observed leads within anchor, then eligible anchors within CVE, then CVEs. Never weight by future change.
continuous_primary_comparison: Day-30 anchor, 30-day lead on the common eligible validation CVEs; report full anchor/lead matrix as secondary, not as an oracle-selected horizon.
continuous_tpg_policy: Separate matched extension only after per-document historical availability is verified. A stored post date or NVD reference date is not authentication of the saved text.
split_policy: Inherit the complete frozen MS04 CVE role manifest without reassignment. Determine task eligibility separately; do not require Day-30 history for the primary study or Day-60 labels for the continuous study. Keep excluded and test CVEs out of development adaptation.

model_components.primary: Frozen shared SecBERT inputs; token-only pooled-text control versus existing EdgeTypeGNNLayer; source attention plus structured MLP; scalar sigmoid Day-60 output. No EPSS input.
model_components.continuous: Variable-length past-only GRU plus anchor/lead-conditioned residual head, shared across every feasible daily anchor and lead. Initialize at persistence; no targets in forward pass.
model_components.component_status: Synthetic forward/backward and masking checks only; cache adapters and full fitting/evaluation runners are separate next stages.

training_loss: MAE; primary gives each CVE equal weight; continuous uses the declared lead/anchor/CVE averaging. Missing targets are masked, not filled.
selection: Prespecified validation MAE criterion, report every seed and ablation; stop after the registered comparison, not endless tuning. Baseline remains preferred if no material supported gain.
classification_interpretation: Thresholded EPSS score categories only; not observed exploitation labels.
test_policy: Three phases: training-only preprocessing and fitting; validation-only selection; freeze protocol, eligible rules, thresholds, variants, checkpoints and hashes before one held-out test release. No test score access in design/preflight. Test ablations use the same frozen cohort and cannot trigger model selection or retuning.
limitations: Current descriptions, summaries and CVSS are retrospective. A unique CVE identifies a vulnerability, not the date a feature was known.
EPSS prediction is score estimation, not direct exploitation prediction; missing labels are never zero.
Development includes all already assigned training/validation CVEs eligible for each task, not all source CVEs or the held-out test set.
Repeated forecasts of one CVE are dependent; evaluation and uncertainty must respect CVE groups.
No observed future value or future outcome is used to select history length, anchor or horizon.
All source combinations are registered, but their full training/cache adapters are not implemented by this design preflight.
Test eligibility counts and test metrics remain unknown until the frozen final evaluation stage.
